column1: What process must sound undergo before it can be saved or processed by a computer?
column2: It must first be digitised.

column1: What is the name of the device that converts an analogue signal into a digital one?
column2: An analogue-to-digital converter (ADC).

column1: In the process of digitising sound, what is sampling?
column2: It is the step of taking measurements of the analogue electrical signal at regular intervals.

column1: What is the term for the number of times a sound wave is sampled per second?
column2: The sample rate.

column1: In what unit of measurement is the sample rate of an audio file expressed?
column2: Hertz (Hz).

column1: Following sampling, what is the name of the process that assigns a binary value to each sample?
column2: Quantization.

column1: What is 'bit depth' in the context of digital audio?
column2: The accuracy of each sample, determining the number of possible amplitude values.

column1: How do a higher sample rate and greater bit depth affect the quality and file size of a recording?
column2: They improve the audio quality but also increase the file size.

column1: What is the standard sample rate for CD quality audio?
column2: 44,100 samples per second (44,100 Hertz).

column1: What is the standard bit depth for CD quality audio?
column2: 16-bit.

column1: The fundamental trade-off in digital audio involves balancing audio quality against _____ _____.
column2: file size

column1: What type of compression, used in formats like .mp3, results in some data being permanently lost?
column2: Lossy compression.

column1: A compressed .mp3 file may be what percentage of the size of the equivalent uncompressed .wav file?
column2: Approximately 10%.

column1: Despite losing quality, why might an .mp3 with lossy compression still sound good?
column2: The quality loss will be hard to detect if a high bitrate is used.

column1: Audio Format: .wav
column2: A typically uncompressed audio format for Windows computers, resulting in large file sizes but high quality.

column1: What is a primary benefit of the .wav audio format?
column2: It is uncompressed, so it maintains the original audio quality, and is widely supported.

column1: What is a primary disadvantage of the .wav audio format?
column2: It has a very large file size because it is typically uncompressed.

column1: Audio Format: .mp3
column2: A format that uses lossy compression to achieve a small file size and is very widely supported.

column1: What is a primary disadvantage of the .mp3 audio format?
column2: There is some permanent loss in audio quality due to its compression method.

column1: Audio Format: .aac
column2: A format offering better sound quality than .mp3 for the same file size, used by iOS, iTunes, and YouTube.

column1: What is a potential disadvantage of using the .aac format?
column2: Not all audio players support it.

column1: Audio Format: FLAC
column2: An open-source format that uses lossless compression, preserving audio quality while reducing file size.

column1: What type of compression does the FLAC audio format use?
column2: Lossless compression.

column1: What is a key benefit of the FLAC format being open source?
column2: Users and developers do not need to pay for licences to use it.
